description: High Occupancy Vehicle is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane, also known as the carpool or diamond lane, is a traffic management strategy to promote and encourage ridesharing; thereby alleviating congestion and maximizing the people-carrying capacity of California highways. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Existing, High Occupancy Vehicle Lanes, HOV. The bounding box given is -122.8075,32.5445,-116.9382,38.7765. The hub shows 2024-08-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This application is being updated for digital accessibility and will continue to function while updates are in progress. ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
